source.note: Indexed profile 01 preserves its pre-lint artifacts/source; profile 02 freezes the final production/index/fixture implementation. Later changes propagate independent CLI/browser fixtures, historical-test raw projection and lint annotation, without changing production or measured Wasm. All source archives and original attempts remain.

shared_tooling.adoption: Canonical reviewed refresh export from a clean detached source into an isolated empty consumer, including the four new pinning/parser files; verify old snapshot before adoption and new snapshot afterward. No vendor hand patch or sibling edits.

contract.owner: One existing local durable funding journal; receipt index in existing accounting memory
contract.credit: Exact full original accepted attachment and immutable nonzero receipt; index binds digest to original operation. Refuse conflict/reuse; replay unchanged. Reopen validates index and complete accounting, without repair.
contract.grant: Host internal, one immutable positive grant per latest fully credited intent; all history reconciled; amount bounded by original acceptance and fixed installed cumulative renewal_ceiling. Replay after later intents is unchanged.
contract.cross_release_disposition: Retire obligations then reinstall; no migration or compatibility reader

profiles.comparison: Two unreleased credit implementations, not current Toko. Restore does more durable index validation; the 10k observation costs 4.76 billion instructions and 47.25MB physical stable memory.

hard_cut.evidence_class: local PocketIC; synthetic verifier; no provider effects

consumer_review.acquisition: Reviewed success/balance does not supply authenticated uniquely attributable receipt or complete activity. Consumer owner must qualify acquisition and two real guarded top-ups; maintainer is not working on Toko.

renewal-check compile corrections and native-funding-01 consistency-fixture failures

raw_retention.exclusions: Expanded shared-source/shared-export/scan-source trees excluded; frozen source archives, export snapshot, all original logs, raw packets, stable snapshots and artifacts included. Manifest itself excluded to avoid self-reference.

limitations: Synthetic receipts/Cashier do not qualify deployed provider credit
Single local Linux observation with fixture observer overhead; no Toko gameplay/upload benchmark or production-size acceptance
No consumer integration, unique provider receipt acquisition or complete live account activity proven
Lifetime slots and fixed cumulative ceiling remain finite; no indefinite funding
Native memory alone has no IC message rollback guarantee
No full CI, version mutation, release, commit, push, publication, deployment, paid effect or sibling edit; no named function/method/type removals
